Went through every issue in the LLC project. My call is on each one, and the plan sheet is here (shared with you and Blake): https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1KcyEpGC8UmDRDwbMVHUMPYoq4PtiGI63J-S4JOJwjXE/edit

What I'd do:
• **LLC takes CF and DD** through Sunset's sale. DD made $183.11 in January (warehouse daily revenue table), which covers the $140/mo its prod account bills now, so it comes over. ZM made $0, so ZM and its AWS account stay with HG.
• **Billing moves to the LLC by Mar 1:** DD prod AWS $140, CF backend/auth $62 (Blake got it down from $95). AppsFlyer free tier for CF, $0.
• **Blake already pays himself through May:** Metabase $100, dbt $100, GitHub $48 = $248. Those count toward his third.
• **Everything else stays with HG:** Singular, Figma (prepaid to Sep, so not LLC like the draft had it), Unity Pro (CF is fine on Personal), Slack/Google/Linear/Deel/Gusto/Intuit/Carta, build boxes, the cancelled tools, the Apple and Play accounts, the playable one-off. Calm Play isn't used, since the LLC is the new one you and Blake are setting up.
• **One snag:** Apple rejected DD on Friday because in-app support only opens an email draft. ENG-2462 is back in Todo for Blake to add a support URL.

**Cost, March through May:** $450 a month all in ($202 billed to the LLC plus Blake's $248), so **$150 each per month**. You and I each put in $150 cash. Blake puts in $0 because his $248 already covers his third, and the LLC pays him back the extra $98 a month.
